Nguyễn Huy Hoàng (born 1 January 1996) is a Vietnamese agricultural practitioner. His activities related to the supply of agricultural inputs in the Central Highlands of Vietnam, particularly in Đắk Nông Province, have been reported by Vietnamese news media.
Early life and education
Nguyễn Huy Hoàng was born in 1996 in Đắk Nông Province, Vietnam. According to press reports, he received formal training in plant protection. After completing his education, he remained in the Central Highlands and became involved in agriculture-related activities.
Career
According to Vietnamese media sources, Hoàng has been involved in the agricultural supply sector since around 2016, working with businesses providing fertilizers and other agricultural inputs to farmers in the Central Highlands region.
In 2025, he was reported to have established an agricultural input supply point operating under the name Hoàng Phát Nông Nghiệp Xanh in Đắk R’lấp District, Đắk Nông Province (now part of Lâm Đồng Province). Media coverage described the operation as supplying agricultural materials and sharing cultivation-related information with local farmers.
His activities in the agricultural sector have also been mentioned in reports by other regional and national news outlets.
